target.title: fix(embeddings): bound openai-compatible requests without AbortSignal
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

OpenAI-compatible embedding HTTP calls only forwarded an optional caller `AbortSignal`. Gateway `/v1/embeddings` and capability-CLI paths call `embed` / `embedBatch` without a signal, so a server that accepts the TCP connection but never sends headers could hang the request forever. Memory/wiki callers already install their own deadlines; this gap is the unsignaled transport path.

## Why This Change Was Made

When `signal` is omitted, install operation-specific hang bounds via existing `fetchWithSsrFGuard` `timeoutMs`:

- `embed` (query): 60s — aligned with memory remote query defaults
- `embedBatch` (batch): 120s — aligned with memory remote batch defaults so gateway/CLI batches are not clamped below established batch policy

When a caller already provides a signal, leave that deadline alone so memory search / tool timeouts are not clamped.

No new config surface. Test-only override shortens the floor for hang repros.

## User Impact

**Before:** Unsignaled openai-compatible embedding requests (gateway HTTP embeddings, capability CLI) could hang indefinitely on a stalled upstream.

**After:** Unsignaled query requests fail after 60s; unsignaled batch requests fail after 120s (`TimeoutError` / `request timed out`). Callers that pass `AbortSignal` keep their own budget.

## Evidence

- Changed: `src/plugins/openai-compatible-embedding-provider.ts` (`postEmbeddingRequest`, query/batch floors)
- Production caller under test: `createOpenAICompatibleEmbeddingProvider(...).provider.embed` / `embedBatch` against a real local `node:http` server that never responds
- Regression: `src/plugins/openai-compatible-embedding-provider.test.ts`
- Sibling cases still green in the same file (UTF-16 error bounds, oversized JSON cancel, auth/config paths)

### Unit regression

```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/plugins/openai-compatible-embedding-provider.test.ts --reporter=verbose
```

```text
 ✓ |plugins| ... > uses distinct no-signal floors for query and batch 0ms
 ✓ |plugins| ... > times out embedding requests that never respond when caller omits signal 61ms
 ✓ |plugins| ... > times out unsignaled batch requests that never respond 53ms
 ✓ |plugins| ... > keeps query and batch no-signal floors independent 307ms
 ✓ |plugins| ... > keeps caller AbortSignal deadlines instead of the no-signal transport floor 205ms
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  34 passed (34)
[test] passed 1 Vitest shard in 27.79s
```

### Standalone runtime proof (outside Vitest)

```bash
node --import tsx <<'EOF'
# production createOpenAICompatibleEmbeddingProvider().provider.embedBatch / embed
# against real hung node:http (accepts body, never writes response)
EOF
```

```text
standalone-proof: openai-compatible embedding no-signal hang bounds
{"queryDefaultMs":60000,"batchDefaultMs":120000}
[fetch-timeout] fetch timeout after 180ms (elapsed 181ms) operation=fetchWithSsrFGuard url=http://127.0.0.1:49522/v1/embeddings
{"proof":"standalone-production-provider-embedBatch-no-signal","path":"createOpenAICompatibleEmbeddingProvider().provider.embedBatch","callerShape":"gateway embeddings-http / capability CLI (unsignaled)","upstream":"real node:http accepts body, never writes response","batchResult":{"ok":false,"error":{"name":"TimeoutError","message":"request timed out"}},"batchElapsedMs":207,"expectedFloorMs":180,"rejectedBeforeHangCap":true}
[fetch-timeout] fetch timeout after 80ms (elapsed 80ms) operation=fetchWithSsrFGuard url=http://127.0.0.1:49522/v1/embeddings
{"proof":"standalone-production-provider-embed-no-signal","path":"createOpenAICompatibleEmbeddingProvider().provider.embed","queryResult":{"ok":false,"error":{"name":"TimeoutError","message":"request timed out"}},"queryElapsedMs":85,"expectedFloorMs":80,"rejectedBeforeHangCap":true}
{"proof":"standalone-caller-AbortSignal-not-clamped","signaled":{"type":"still-pending"}}
standalone-proof: done
```

## Real behavior proof

- **Behavior or issue addressed:** Unsignaled openai-compatible embedding POSTs no longer hang forever when the upstream accepts the connection but never responds; query and batch use distinct floors (60s / 120s).
- **Canonical reachability path:** gateway `embeddings-http` / capability CLI / direct provider → `createOpenAICompatibleEmbeddingProvider` → `embed` (query) or `embedBatch` (batch) → `postEmbeddingRequest` → `fetchWithSsrFGuard({ timeoutMs })` when `signal` is absent.
- **Boundary crossed:** Operator/remote OpenAI-compatible embedding HTTP → local AbortSignal timeout via guarded fetch.
- **Shared helper / provider constraint check:** Reuses `fetchWithSsrFGuard` `timeoutMs` / `buildTimeoutAbortSignal`. Query/batch floors match memory-core remote budgets (`60_000` / `120_000`). Does not override caller-owned signals used by memory-core `runEmbeddingOperationWithTimeout`. Does not add config/env.
- **Real environment tested:** Local Node 22 source checkout on macOS; production provider path via standalone `node --import tsx` (outside Vitest) against real `http.createServer` on `127.0.0.1` that reads the body and never writes a response; shortened test floors for hang repro.
- **Exact steps or command run after this patch:**

```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/plugins/openai-compatible-embedding-provider.test.ts --reporter=verbose
node --import tsx  # standalone production provider embedBatch/embed against hung socket
```

- **Evidence after fix:**

```text
Unit:
 ✓ ... > uses distinct no-signal floors for query and batch
 ✓ ... > times out embedding requests that never respond when caller omits signal 61ms
 ✓ ... > times out unsignaled batch requests that never respond 53ms
 ✓ ... > keeps query and batch no-signal floors independent 307ms
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  34 passed (34)

Standalone (outside Vitest):
{"queryDefaultMs":60000,"batchDefaultMs":120000}
[fetch-timeout] fetch timeout after 180ms ... embedBatch → TimeoutError
[fetch-timeout] fetch timeout after 80ms ... embed → TimeoutError
{"proof":"standalone-caller-AbortSignal-not-clamped","signaled":{"type":"still-pending"}}
standalone-proof: done
```

- **Observed result after fix:** Unsignaled `embedBatch` (gateway/CLI shape) and `embed` reject with `TimeoutError` / `request timed out` on a real hung socket; defaults are 60s query / 120s batch; caller-provided `AbortSignal` is not clamped by the no-signal floor.
- **What was not tested:** Live public embedding APIs; full gateway HTTP `/v1/embeddings` end-to-end against a hung upstream; memory-core batch paths (already signal-backed).
- **Fix classification:** Root cause fix

- [x] AI-assisted (Cursor)
- [x] I understand what the code does
- [x] Change is focused and does not mix unrelated concerns
